tasks.title: Add a standard-library control-plane validator and status command
acceptance: python project_control.py validate
python project_control.py status
python project_control.py self-test
stop_conditions: Do not modify main or repository security settings

tasks.title: Add control-plane validation to the active deterministic CI
acceptance: The active CI invokes the validator
A malformed-state negative test fails
stop_conditions: Do not replace or merge an unrelated CI workflow without diff review

tasks.title: Audit active v0.1 implementation against the roadmap and create evidence-backed task contracts
acceptance: Every milestone claim links to a current source revision or artifact
Open work is represented as independently verifiable tasks
Unknowns are recorded as blockers or hypotheses, not assumed facts
stop_conditions: Do not claim model success or runtime selection without evidence

tasks.title: Audit reboot-core CI baseline and the staging fast-CI candidate
acceptance: Reboot-core base revision is pinned and its associated workflow runs are inventoried
The staging CI branch is compared without merging its divergent history
Candidate CI risks and a safe port sequence are recorded
stop_conditions: Do not merge the stale staging branch wholesale
Do not weaken required security or integration tests

tasks.title: Establish evidence ledger and automated claims checks
acceptance: Evidence IDs resolve to immutable source/artifact references
Claims lint rejects unsupported pass/accepted claims
Run records include canceled and ineligible states
stop_conditions: Never synthesize run IDs, hashes, or benchmark metrics

tasks.title: Port and test the path-aware fast runner on reboot-core
acceptance: Deleted source/test paths select the affected suite
Project-control changes select the validator/self-test suite
Path selection and cross-suite dependencies have unit tests
All selected deterministic suites pass on the reboot-core base
stop_conditions: Do not port the divergent branch history
Do not claim staging timings as reboot-core measurements

tasks.title: Consolidate workflow policy without losing manual and extended checks
acceptance: All 15 legacy workflow responsibilities are mapped
Unified L0/L1/L2 triggers and permissions are reviewed
Layer 0 and Layer 1 pass in one workflow run after the workflow is present in the base branch
E-002 benchmark and E-009 ten-run confirmation are manual-only
CPU-only model runs are explicitly non-acceptance diagnostics
No workflow concurrency policy cancels in-flight evidence
Legacy workflow deletion is covered by the verified unified workflow
expected_outputs: First authoritative run after base branch includes the workflow
stop_conditions: Do not enable unattended paid model runs
